provisions.meaning: When under deck, mechanical ventilation must meet SOLAS II-2/19 (II-2/54) requirements for flammable liquids with flashpoint below 23 degrees C closed cup.
Shade cargo transport units from direct sunlight; arrange packages to allow adequate air circulation throughout the cargo.
Unit loads in open cargo transport units use stowage category B.
Category A applies when transported in accordance with P650.
Batteries transported under special provisions 376 or 377 use category C unless on a short international voyage.
Uranyl nitrate hexahydrate solution uses stowage category D.
Pyrophoric uranium metal and pyrophoric thorium metal use stowage category D.
For BK3 bulk containers consult 7.6.2.12 and 7.7.3.9.
Keep as dry as reasonably practicable.
Keep as cool as reasonably practicable.
Minimize handling of packaging or large packaging; inform the appropriate public health or veterinary authority if people or animals may have been exposed.
